name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate and split votes
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Temporary Decarbonisation Fund
part_text: (7) The Fund’s resources should only be used to cover the commitments to pay financial support to the final beneficiaries and the administrative costs of the Fund. Any unused revenue could be reallocated as additional contributions to international climate finance under Article 9 of the Paris Agreement.
